narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers that fine lines on the skin are often caused by inflammation and dehydration rather than permanent aging/wrinkles. It identifies common triggers like sun exposure, mites, or excessive moisturizing and promotes professional dermatological consultation at the DRX clinic to address the root causes.
